activate.title: Activate AI
activate.subtitle: Let your own computer recognise your plants.

local.title: The AI runs on your PC
local.desc: Recognition happens on your machine (your graphics card), not on our servers.

connect.title: It links itself
connect.desc: Your PC connects out to verdure — nothing to configure, no address to type.

anywhere.title: The app everywhere, the AI at home
anywhere.desc: You use verdure from anywhere; your photos are recognised by your PC, then sent back.

req.gpu: An NVIDIA graphics card with at least 4 GB of video memory (VRAM)
req.ram: 16 GB of RAM recommended (8 GB minimum)
req.disk: ~10 GB of free disk space (the models download on first launch)

private.title: 100% private
private.desc: Your photos are recognised on your computer; they never leave your machine.

power.title: The power of your PC
power.desc: The AI runs on your own NVIDIA graphics card — fast, with no usage limits.

free.title: Free
free.desc: No subscription, no server cost: it's your hardware doing the work.

activate.error: That didn't work. Please try again.

pair.title: Connect this computer
pair.prompt: A computer is asking to enable AI on your account:
pair.warning: Only confirm if this code is showing on YOUR computer. This program will be able to process your plant photos.
pair.approved: All set! Your computer is connected. You can head back to the app.
pair.notFound: No valid connection request for this code. The program makes a new one on its own — try again with the new link.
pair.error: That didn't work. Please try again.
